name: StepRndFlt
description: Tempo-synced sample-and-hold LFO into a multimode resonant TPT SVF on AUDIO IN. Each step redraws a random cutoff offset around CUT. TYPE pairs each mode with a *R variant that also S&H's the filter dry/wet mix each step (slewed with SLEW). X = LFO depth, Y = resonance (capped). LEVEL scales wet into a final softclip. Hold the pad to engage; release returns to dry.

params.name: DEPTH
params.detail: How far each S&H step moves cutoff around CUT (± octaves)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the pad is held

params.name: CUT
params.detail: Center cutoff the S&H LFO modulates around

params.name: TYPE
params.detail: Filter mode pairs: Peak/PeakR, LP12/LP12R, LP24/LP24R, BPF/BPFR, HP12/HP12R, HP24/HP24R (*R = per-step random filter mix)

params.name: SLEW
params.detail: How quickly cutoff (and *R mix) glide to each new random value

params.name: LEVEL
params.detail: Wet level into the final softclip
